rewrites.original: Direct-exec (no AI in loop) — runner spawns the Python script directly. Use when the cockpit "GitHub Trending" card fires a refresh-new intent, or when manually invoked via /github-trending.
rewrites.replacement: Deterministic (no AI in the loop) — run the bundled script and return its report unchanged. Use when asked for GitHub trending repos, before Morning Intel, or when invoked via /github-trending.
rewrites.reason: The original description named the agentic-os runner and cockpit card that triggered the script; a skill is triggered by the user or by Morning Intel.

rewrites.original:
## How runner invokes

Listed in `runner.js → isDirectExec` set. Runner spawns `python scripts/fetch.py` with `cwd: VAULT_ROOT`. Script writes the file. Runner logs exit code + first line.
rewrites.replacement:
## How content-os invokes

Run `node <skill-dir>/scripts/github-trending/run.mjs`. It runs the unchanged `scripts/github-trending/fetch.py` with the vault as its output root (up to three attempts on HTTP 502/503/504, timeouts and connection resets, as the agentic-os runner did), then prints the snapshot the script wrote.
rewrites.reason: The agentic-os runner (direct-exec set) launched the script; in content-os the bundled run.mjs wrapper does, with the same retry rule as directWorkflow in workflows.mjs.

Writes to vault if `AGENTIC_OS_VAULT` env var set, else `~/the-vault`.
rewrites.replacement:
```bash
AGENTIC_OS_VAULT="$CONTENT_OS_VAULT" python3 "<skill-dir>/scripts/github-trending/fetch.py"
```

Writes to the directory in `AGENTIC_OS_VAULT`. Always set it (run.mjs does): without it the unchanged script falls back to its agentic-os defaults.
rewrites.reason: The script path and default vault were agentic-os installation paths. fetch.py itself is unchanged; content-os always gives it the vault through AGENTIC_OS_VAULT, which also keeps it from reading any agentic-os dotenv file.
